svg.aria-label: Arooj Qureshi, AI governance advisor for regulated industries: from notebook to production. A model moves through five stages: notebook prototype, retrieval with RAG and GraphRAG, agents with LangGraph and guardrails, an LLM-as-judge eval gate, and monitored, auditable production on Vertex AI.
svg.text: I take AI out of the prototype and into systems people rely on.
